name: ASML Holding N.V.
business_model: Sells lithography systems (sole EUV supplier; leading DUV supplier) plus metrology/inspection and computational lithography; about a quarter of revenue from installed-base service and field upgrades.

name: Carl Zeiss SMT GmbH
business_model: Exclusive supplier of lithography optics (optical columns, illuminators, collectors, mirrors) to ASML; also photomask and wafer-fab solutions. Owned via Carl Zeiss SMT Holding GmbH & Co. KG (24.9% ASML, rest Carl Zeiss AG).
products: EUV and High-NA EUV projection optics and illumination systems

name: Carl Zeiss AG
business_model: Optics group owned by the Carl Zeiss Foundation; four segments, the largest being Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology.

name: TRUMPF SE + Co. KG
business_model: Family-owned machine-tool and laser maker; its EUV business field builds the high-power CO2 drive laser (TRUMPF Laser Amplifier) for ASML EUV sources.
products: TRUMPF Laser Amplifier (CO2 drive laser for EUV)

name: Cymer, LLC
business_model: Independently operated ASML business (acquired 2013) that develops, makes and services ArF/KrF excimer DUV light sources from San Diego; also ASML's light-source centre of excellence.
products: ArF and KrF excimer laser light sources

name: Gigaphoton Inc.
business_model: Komatsu-owned maker of excimer laser light sources for lithography tools; earns most revenue from consumables/maintenance on its installed base (per Komatsu).

name: Nikon Corporation
business_model: Diversified optics company; Precision Equipment segment sells semiconductor (i-line, KrF, ArF, ArF immersion) and FPD lithography systems, new and refurbished.

name: Canon Inc.
business_model: Diversified imaging company; Industrial Business Unit sells i-line and KrF semiconductor lithography, packaging lithography, FPD lithography and nanoimprint systems.

name: Shanghai Micro Electronics Equipment (Group) Co., Ltd.
business_model: China's principal domestic lithography tool maker (affiliated with Shanghai Electric Group per press); claims 90 nm ArF production systems.

name: Intel Corporation
business_model: Logic IDM with an external foundry business; first High-NA EUV adopter.

name: VDL Enabling Technologies Group
business_model: Contract maker of high-precision mechanical modules; reported supplier of mechanical structures for ASML EUV stage systems.

name: Prodrive Technologies
business_model: Electronics and mechatronics supplier; reported supplier of linear motors and servo drives for ASML EUV maglev stages.
